echo "== STEP install packages =="

adduser -D -h /srv/data -s /sbin/nologin datauser

mkdir -p /srv/data

echo "== STEP mount =="
mountpoint -q /srv/data && umount /srv/data || true
mount /srv/data
mount | grep /srv/data

echo "== STEP ownership =="
chown datauser:datauser /srv/data
chmod 750 /srv/data

echo "== STEP quotacheck + quotaon =="
